expectations.text: Writes 100 to $D012 and handles the 9th bit (bit 7 of $D011, cleared for line 100)
expectations.evidence: lda #100 / sta $d012; then lda $d011 / and #$7f / sta $d011 clears bit 7 for line <256

expectations.text: Enables the raster interrupt by setting bit 0 of $D01A
expectations.evidence: lda #$01 / sta $d01a sets bit 0 = raster IRQ enable

expectations.text: Acknowledges the interrupt by writing to $D019 in the handler
expectations.evidence: irq handler: lda #$01 / sta $d019 writes set bit to ack

expectations.text: Sets the IRQ vector ($0314/$0315 or $FFFE) and uses SEI/CLI appropriately
expectations.evidence: sei at setup start, writes <irq/>irq to $0314/$0315, cli at end
